title-info.book-title: Tribulation of Myriad Races — Chapter 1832: Fate realm (2)

section.p: Understanding dawned on Su Yu. He sighed and said, “I understand. I know how much of the pen dao I have fused with. It is only a tiny stretch of the entire tributary. And I missed a lot of details in the part I had fused with. I never paid them much thought. I don’t truly understand the part that is supposed to be mine.”

Su Yu smiled and said, “I was too focused on the path ahead, but I neglected the scenery. The Heaven Gate was immensely helpful, but it also created some bad habits. I should be paying more attention to the little details.”

Wan Tiansheng nodded and said, “The Heaven Gate is amazing. It allows you to see the nature of daos. It will be powerful in any era. But there must be a difference between those with Heaven Gate opened. Some might neglect the little details like you, getting too confident and eventually finding themselves stuck.”

Su Yu thought about it and nodded, “Yes. I understand now. Martial Emperor. His arrogance has severed his path forward. He must have opened his Heaven Gate earlier than Culture King and the others, but just Martial King was capable of defeating and suppressing him.

“If I’m guessing things right, the Human Emperor and the four major kings had all opened the Heaven Gate. Martial Emperor was probably weaker than them despite being a senior to them. He must have advanced blindly in the process of growing his dao. Indeed, he is a brute.”

Su Yu came to understand many things. Some of his previous questions were finally answered. He had been curious about Martial Emperor. How was he so weak that he couldn’t even defeat Martial King. They had all opened the Heaven Gate. Su Yu believed that only supreme geniuses could open the Heaven Gate.

But he finally understood. Martial Emperor must not have bothered to understand his own path. He must have advanced blindly the moment he saw a powerful dao, just like what Su Yu had been doing with the pen dao.
At this rate, Su Yu would have no ability to strengthen the pen dao upon mastering it. He wouldn’t even have the ability to pioneer a new dao. He would only have his eyes on the pen dao.
Even after pioneering a new dao, he would dislike it because it would be too weak. After seeing a mountain, how could a mere hill catch his attention?

Seeing that understanding was dawning on Su Yu, Wan Tiansheng smiled and said, “You’re a smart man. You’re different from Martial Emperor. I never met him, but I can feel that he’s a stupid brute. They were probably not the only ones with the Heaven Gate open. There must have been more, but their strength differed. Clearly, their comprehension of the daos was different.”
Su Yu nodded. He said curiously, “Principal, you don’t have the Heaven Gate. You don’t even have all the acupoints and apertures open. How are you so strong?”

“No, it’s not that people like me are strong. You are simply too weak.” Wan Tiansheng shook his head and said, “You have a far bigger potential than any of us. There is no doubt. I won’t be your match at the same cultivation level. You have just initiated your dao fusion. You are not at that cultivation level yet.”

“Oh.” Su Yu said, “You are indeed a learned man, Principal. I am curious. The various races have so many ancient fossils, but none of them feel too knowledgeable. You have only been alive for a hundred years, but you feel much more experienced than they.”
Wan Tiansheng laughed and said, “You’re only twenty-one. What do you think about your knowledge base?”
“Decent.”
“Compared to your peers?”

“Naturally, I have a far higher knowledge base. I studied the cultivation methods of the myriad races before. I witnessed the experts of the various races before. I explored the past, traversing the worlds of the living and death, pursuing the real nature of the myriad daos. Meanwhile, my peers are still working hard to grow as Skysoars.”

“There you have it.” Wan Tiansheng said, “At present, the Myriad Realms are filled with mediocre people. The fossils are either busy slumbering or killing each other. They only focus on cultivation for the sole purpose of gaining strength without asking themselves about the source of strength.

“They don’t know what they want to do with that strength. They only want strength. This is the same as dreaming. Let me give you an example. When these people start dao fusion, what will be their first method to grow stronger?”
Su Yu thought about it and said, “Kill the other people pursuing the same dao.”
“Exactly.” Wan Tiansheng laughed and said, “This is the thought of a mediocre person.”
Su Yu looked sheepish as that was his thought as well. The principal was clearly insulting him here.
“What do you think one should do, then?”
“Me?” Wan Tiansheng thought about it and said, “Plunder the comprehension of others.”

Su Yu frowned. Wan Tiansheng explained further, “With ten people on a single dao, and with you mastering one tenth of it, this does not signify that the others have snatched your portion. Rather, it signifies that they have comprehended different things about the dao.

“There are ten aspects to this dao, and you have only comprehended one. To grow, you need to comprehend new things, things others have comprehended. When your comprehension surpasses theirs, you can take everything they have for yourselves. Squeeze them out and take over everything.”

Understanding dawned on Su Yu as he said, “And this is why Masters of Laws are so powerful. They have comprehended a lot more. Fighting over the dao with them is the same as fighting a stone with an egg. They can easily expel someone from their daos.”

“Yes!” Wan Tiansheng said, “A day may come when you master the pen dao. You will believe that as a Master of Law, nobody can snatch the dao from you. But Culture King might understand the dao better than you. He can instantly snatch it from you, removing your control over the dao. At the time, you will be completely helpless before him.”

Su Yu nodded again and said, “Yes. That is very true. In short, I need to find a chance to get rid of Culture King. Is that what you’re saying? Are you trying to provoke a fight between me and Culture King?”
Wan Tiansheng flashed a gentle smile and said, “Not at all.”
“Principal, are you still holding a grudge toward him?”
“Impossible!”
Su Yu laughed and said, “That must be the case. Why would you mention him for no reason?”
“I was merely setting a relatable example for you.”

Su Yu laughed and said, “You are right. I will keep this in mind. I don’t want to have flowers growing from my arse like Martial Emperor. He was talented enough to open the Heaven Gate, yet he was met with such a miserable end.”
“Indeed. Martial Emperor is truly useless.”
Wan Tiansheng nodded in agreement. In such a manner, the two juniors who were as strong as Daofuses started criticizing a Master of Law. One that might be incredibly powerful.
Just because Martial Emperor wasn’t Martial King’s match did not mean that he wasn’t a match for other Masters of Laws. No matter what, he was genius enough to open the Heaven Gate.
But in the eyes of Su Yu and Wan Tiansheng, it was precisely because of his Heaven Gate that he was disappointingly weak.
A short moment later.
Both Su Yu and Wan Tiansheng walked out of a rift in thin air.
Instantly, golden and crimson clouds gathered in the sky. Wan Tiansheng glanced at Su Yu, wondering if he should hide somewhere.
Su Yu considered the matter and shook his head. “A tribulation is also a way to comprehend new things. Don’t worry. A single tribulation is not enough to drain the heavenly paws too much.”
Wan Tiansheng smiled and said, “In that case, let me experience the feeling of having both a heavenly reward and a heavenly tribulation at the same time.”

With a single step, he reappeared in the sky. The clouds started converging around him. With his left hand, he suppressed the crimson clouds. With his right hand, he gathered the golden clouds. He focused on sensing the power of laws around him while suppressing the crimson clouds with a massive palm.

The tribulation was here to punish his dao affirmation. This was a punishment meant to deal with Sunmoons. At most, it would reach the level of a fourth or fifth-degree Eternal in strength. Wan Tiansheng was too strong, so the punishment might have been further boosted to the sixth or seventh degree in strength.
But for Wan Tiansheng, it was still too weak. Done with comprehending the clouds, he smiled and nonchalantly slapped the crimson clouds apart. Just like that, the tribulation was over.
Down below, the various soldiers watched with stupefaction.
Meanwhile, the Eternals were watching solemnly.
That wasn’t a weak tribulation. It was surprisingly powerful. But Wan Tiansheng had easily scattered it. Just how strong was he now?
Great Zhou King was looking at Wan Tiansheng as well. He frowned, feeling like he had finally met his match.
Wan Tiansheng was finally an Eternal.
A proper Eternal.
He seemed to have pioneered a new dao instead of fusing with an existing dao. There was no Daofuse Realm for someone like that. He would remain an Eternal.
Shortly after, Wan Tiansheng landed on the ground again.
Standing beside Su Yu, he flashed Great Zhou King a gentle smile and said, “Greetings, Great Zhou King. I was in a rush earlier and couldn’t greet you. Please forgive this junior’s rudeness.”
“You’re too polite.” Great Zhou King nodded.

Wan Tiansheng smiled again and said, “You deserve my respect. You have protected humanity for countless years. Now that Emperor Yu has established the Clearfilth Office, I have a heavy duty on my shoulders. I will be relying on your guidance for my tasks moving forward, Senior. This includes the capture of the traitors in the Upper Realm. You are more familiar with the humans there. I hope to obtain your cooperation in this matter.”
Great Zhou King smiled and said, “Sure. I will tell you all I know.”

Once again, Wan Tiansheng nodded. He said, “In that case, I’ll be troubling you. When Emperor Yu conquers the Myriad Realms, your massive contributions will definitely be recorded in the laws, and your feats will be known for eternity. Countless generations of humanity will remember your great contributions to humanity.”
Great Zhou King’s face twitched slightly as he said, “No, that’s too much. I am just a normal human.”

“No, not at all.” Wan Tiansheng said, “With your help, chaos ended among humanity and order returned. Emperor Yu was only able to ascend thanks to you. You were the one who had suppressed all dissidents. And Emperor Yu did not disappoint. On his first day as the human lord, he spilled the blood of Daofuses, establishing the might of humanity. Your keen eyesight is unparalleled. In fact, not even I had expected Emperor Yu to do so well.”

He smiled and continued, “When traitors appear in the future, when villains attempt to steal the fortune of humanity, we will be relying on you to bring order to chaos yet again. Your assistance is required to defend the legitimate leader of humanity.”
Legitimate?
